[[File:Shvash_gas_harvesting.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Farmers collecting shvash gas on Gelgelar aboard repulsor barges]]
'''Repulsor barges''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles used by swamp [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]] to collect [[shvash gas]]. The gas was collected in pressure tanks for transport to [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
